subject: Monitors for summary but not sampling

messages.author: daa09ea2c86c34e5
messages.subject: Monitors for summary but not sampling
parts:
Hi all,

I'm fairly new to NIMBLE and the world of MCMC. My model has a lot of nodes. To save memory, I was wondering whether it was possible to return summary for all nodes using the runMCMC() but samples for only some monitored nodes (i.e, a select few to see if the model is converging). This assumes summary does not need all the values previously sampled and can be calculated in a 'rolling' sense.

Cheers,

Theo

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Monitors for summary but not sampling
parts:
Hi Theo,
I believe summary is not calculated in a rolling manner.  One strategy is to use the both monitors and monitors2, which can have different thinning intervals, thin and thin2.  You could use monitors for the primary parameters of interest with less thinning, and monitors2 for the other variables with lots of nodes with a much higher thinning interval so you can look at their mixing with less memory burden.  You can set both monitors in configureMCMC (or buildMCMC if you are skipping configureMCMC directly) and both thin values in runMCMC.
-Perry
